coverage_caveats.drop-seq: Historical Nextera XT Rev D guide is contextual; the paper does not establish that exact guide revision. Do not transfer general guide parameters into unstated historical conditions.
coverage_caveats.dnase-seq: Packet contains main and 33-page supplemental PDF; separate cited Crawford2006 DNase-chip source must be assessed if its validation branch/delegated steps enter scope. Preserve Solexa/454 alternatives rather than applying one library recipe to both.

evaluation_design_audit.reference_status: A model-authored draft is a provisional reference, not human gold. Human source-first review should identify what was checked, uncertain, disputed or intentionally unassessed.
evaluation_design_audit.independence: A second LLM can expose disagreements but is not independent scientific ground truth. Reference curation must not only adjudicate candidate outputs or copy the evaluated harness graph.
stage_separation: Source acquisition: exact paper identity, original delivery, supplement association, cited dependency closure and rendition fidelity.
Extraction: give all systems the same frozen packet; score supported obligations, contradictions and uncertainty with source locators.
Matching: freeze local occurrences and separately test concept retrieval, scope admission, comparator judgments and publication.
evaluation_design_audit.valid_decomposition_policy: Permit multiple source-supported refinements/coarsenings. Compare preserved molecular states, transformations, branches, barcode/coordinate provenance and information obligations through explicit many-to-many correspondences; do not use exact node counts or labels as the primary correctness criterion.
evaluation_design_audit.partial_gold_limits: Precision is only defined for assessed predictions; missing reference entries are not automatic negatives. Recall applies only to a declared exhaustively assessed obligation set. Report unassessed items and denominators separately.
acceptable_invariants: Supported directed material flow; no unsupported cycles or transitions.
Input/output molecular entity and association remain traceable across required transformations.
Cell, sample, UMI and spatial identities retain their source-supported introduction and inheritance paths.
Reported alternatives, split/pool steps, and branches survive; required ordered chemistry cannot be reversed by graph coarsening.
Explicit absence, unknown and not-assessed remain distinct and do not create semantic agreement.
Shared purpose does not imply shared mechanism, compatibility, history or component interchangeability.
Every assessed scientific obligation binds to the exact primary/supplement bytes and appropriate locator; unsupported details are not supplied from later revisions.
counterexample_controls: Reverse a required conversion/adapter/amplification order while retaining labels.
Merge or delete a reported preparation/readout alternative.
Move cell/spatial barcode introduction past pooling or erase the decoding/capture branch join.
Substitute a later kit revision or related protocol to fill a historical unknown.
Equate different metabolic conversion mechanisms because purpose/label is shared.
Supply a plausible label match with incompatible input state or scope.
Compare two valid coarse/fine decompositions preserving identical obligations and require both to pass.
Add unsupported detail to a sparse protocol and require it to reduce supported precision rather than earn completeness credit.
